item.title: QB Ty Simpson 7th Overall!? RB Jeremiyah Love is a DUDE + WR Makai Lemon Drops | Drive to the Draft | Washington Commanders | NFL
item.description: The guys discuss day three of the 2026 NFL Combine. Ty Simpson may have found his way into the 7th overall pick, but who would trade up with Washington to grab the young QB? Then, it's a complete in-depth evaluation of all the WRs including the inevitability of Carnell Tate, the supposed drop of Makai Lemon, and if KC Concepcion is hot or cold. Next, they marvel at Jeremiyah Love and debate if positional value matters anymore when drafting blue-chip prospects! Hosts: Logan Paulsen, Jason Johnson
